#mrsfisher.Face.Normal
You: I want to try again.
Mrs. Fisher: You did good last time. Think you can do it again?
You: I would like to say I will try my best, but I have no idea what is even happening, so…
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Grin+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: Right. I totally forgot you are a lightweight.
You: …
#mrsfisher.Face.Normal
Mrs. Fisher: Just remember the deal, no more than one puff. It could get troublesome otherwise.
You: Sure…
You: Here I go-
